BiblicalUsage: Cain is marked with sevenfold vengeance, the words of the LORD are purified seven times like silver tried in a furnace, the thief restores sevenfold, and the light of the sun will be sevenfold in the day the LORD binds up the breach of His people. Seven times is the measure of complete repayment and complete cleansing.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sevenfold tells me God finishes what He starts, whether it is judgment or mercy. I hold that the same God who repays sevenfold also purifies sevenfold, and I would rather be purified by Him than repaid by Him.
